spec.description: Drilldown for the Claude Prompts dashboard: prompt usage per repository, user, model and mode, with the same filters.

spec.rawSql:
-- base is every prompt the panel counts, labelled once; metrics and skills are grouped from it
-- separately, because joining skills into the metrics would repeat a prompt once per skill.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.workspace_key, p.session_id, p.prompt_id, p.repository_url,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    CASE WHEN p.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS model,
    CASE p.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE p.permission_mode END AS mode,
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '') AS full_name,
    p.estimated_cost_usd, p.input_tokens, p.output_tokens, p.cache_read_tokens, p.cache_creation_tokens, p.used_skill
  FROM ai_prompts p
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.command_name <> 'exit'
), r AS (
  SELECT repository_url, user, model, mode,
    MAX(full_name) AS full_name,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens,
    SUM(cache_creation_tokens) AS cache_creation_tokens,
    AVG(used_skill) AS skill_share
  FROM base
  GROUP BY repository_url, user, model, mode
), sk AS (
  SELECT b.repository_url, b.user, b.model, b.mode,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.skill_name ORDER BY s.skill_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS skills
  FROM base b
  JOIN ai_prompt_skills s ON s.workspace_key = b.workspace_key AND s.session_id = b.session_id AND s.prompt_id = b.prompt_id
  GROUP BY b.repository_url, b.user, b.model, b.mode
)
SELECT r.repository_url AS "Repository",
  COALESCE(dl.projects, 'Unmapped') AS "Project",
  COALESCE(r.full_name, r.user) AS "User",
  r.model AS "Model",
  r.mode AS "Mode",
  r.prompts AS "Prompts",
  r.prompts / SUM(r.prompts) OVER () AS "Share",
  r.sessions AS "Sessions",
  r.cost AS "Cost",
  r.cost / r.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  r.input_tokens / r.prompts AS "Input Tokens per Prompt",
  r.output_tokens / r.prompts AS "Output Tokens per Prompt",
  r.cache_read_tokens / r.prompts AS "Cache Read Tokens per Prompt",
  r.cache_creation_tokens / r.prompts AS "Cache Write Tokens per Prompt",
  r.skill_share AS "Skill Usage",
  COALESCE(sk.skills, '') AS "Skills"
FROM r
-- repository_url is NULL for prompts without a repository, so match it NULL-safely.
LEFT JOIN sk ON sk.repository_url <=> r.repository_url AND sk.user = r.user AND sk.model = r.model AND sk.mode = r.mode
LEFT JOIN (
  -- repository_url is lowercased with the .git suffix dropped, so normalize repos.url the same way.
  SELECT TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url)) AS url,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pm.project_name ORDER BY pm.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS projects
  FROM repos rp
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rp.id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  GROUP BY TRIM(TRAILING '.git' FROM LOWER(rp.url))
) dl ON dl.url = r.repository_url
ORDER BY 1, 3, r.prompts DESC

spec.description: Prompts, sessions, cost and average input, output, cache read and cache write tokens per prompt for each repository the prompt ran in, from the origin remote Claude Code reports, split by user, the model or combination of models the prompt used, and permission mode. Share is of all prompts shown. Repository 'Unknown' means the session had no origin remote or the client did not report one. Model 'N/A' means the prompt made no model request, such as a local slash command. Project is the DevLake project that also collects the repository, or 'Unmapped' when none does. /exit prompts are left out. Skills lists the distinct skills those prompts used, and is empty when none did.
spec.title: Prompt Usage by Repository

spec.rawSql:
SELECT f.occurred_at AS "Time",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''), NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS "User",
  p.repository_url AS "Repository",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN 'API' ELSE 'Tool' END AS "Kind",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) ELSE f.tool_name END AS "Tool / Model",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), CONCAT('HTTP ', f.status_code), 'Unknown') AS "Error",
  NULLIF(f.error_message, '') AS "Message",
  CASE WHEN f.failure_kind <> 'api_error' THEN '' WHEN f.query_source = 'repl_main_thread' THEN 'Main conversation' WHEN f.query_source LIKE 'agent:%' THEN CONCAT('Subagent (', SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.query_source, ':', -1), ')') WHEN f.query_source = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CONCAT('Background (', f.query_source, ')') END AS "Source",
  f.duration_ms AS "Duration"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
-- account_id is the user's DevLake account, which carries the full name.
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
ORDER BY f.occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 200

spec.description: The latest 200 failures in the time range, newest first.
spec.title: Recent Failures

spec.rawSql:
SELECT r.label AS "Top API error"
FROM (
  SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(CAST(f.status_code AS CHAR), 'N/A'), ' ', CASE f.status_code
      WHEN 400 THEN 'Bad request' WHEN 401 THEN 'Unauthorized' WHEN 403 THEN 'Forbidden'
      WHEN 404 THEN 'Not found' WHEN 413 THEN 'Request too large' WHEN 429 THEN 'Rate limited'
      WHEN 500 THEN 'Server error' WHEN 503 THEN 'Unavailable' WHEN 529 THEN 'Overloaded'
      ELSE 'Error' END) AS label,
    COUNT(*) AS errors
  FROM ai_prompt_failures f
  JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND f.failure_kind = 'api_error'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY errors DESC, label
  LIMIT 1
) r

spec.description: The most frequent API error by HTTP status, with its count. 429 is a rate limit, 529 an overloaded service. The messages are in Top Failure Reasons.
spec.title: Top API Error

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS "User",
  u.team AS "Team",
  u.model AS "Model",
  u.effort AS "Effort",
  u.mode AS "Mode",
  u.prompts AS "Prompts",
  u.sessions AS "Sessions",
  u.cost AS "Cost",
  u.cost / u.prompts AS "Cost per prompt",
  u.skill_share AS "Used a skill",
  u.command_share AS "Slash command",
  u.tool_failure_rate AS "Tool failure rate"
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    CASE WHEN p.models_used = '' THEN 'N/A' ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.models_used, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 'opus ', 'Opus '), 'sonnet ', 'Sonnet '), 'haiku ', 'Haiku '), 'fable ', 'Fable '), ',', ', ') END AS model,
    CASE p.effort WHEN 'low' THEN 'Low' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'Medium' WHEN 'high' THEN 'High' WHEN 'xhigh' THEN 'XHigh' WHEN 'max' THEN 'Max' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(p.effort, 1)), SUBSTRING(p.effort, 2)), 'N/A') END AS effort,
    CASE p.permission_mode WHEN 'default' THEN 'Agentic' WHEN 'bypassPermissions' THEN 'Bypass Permissions' WHEN 'plan' THEN 'Plan' WHEN 'acceptEdits' THEN 'Accept Edits' WHEN 'auto' THEN 'Auto' ELSE p.permission_mode END AS mode,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.team_slug ORDER BY c.team_slug SEPARATOR ', ') AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS prompts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    AVG(p.used_skill) AS skill_share,
    AVG(p.command_name <> '') AS command_share,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.tool_failure_count) / NULLIF(SUM(p.tool_call_count), 0), 0) AS tool_failure_rate
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = p.source_connection_id
  -- account_id is the user's DevLake account, whose full_name the plugin copies from
  -- another account with the same email.
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
    AND p.command_name <> 'exit'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
) u
ORDER BY 1, u.prompts DESC

spec.description: Per-user prompt volume, cost and habits, split by the model or combination of models the prompt used, its reasoning effort and its permission mode. Model and effort 'N/A' mean the prompt made no model request, such as a local slash command, or the client sent no effort.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT r.reason AS "Top failure reason"
FROM (
  SELECT CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT('API ', COALESCE(f.status_code, 'error')) ELSE CONCAT(f.tool_name, ' · ', COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'error')) END AS reason, COUNT(*) AS failures
  FROM ai_prompt_failures f
  JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
    AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY failures DESC, reason
  LIMIT 1
) r

spec.description: The most frequent failure reason and its count: the tool and error type for tool failures, the HTTP status for API errors.
spec.title: Top Failure

spec.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE(f.occurred_at)) AS time,
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT('API ', COALESCE(f.status_code, 'error')) ELSE CONCAT(f.tool_name, ' · ', COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), 'error')) END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.description: Failures per UTC day, stacked by reason. API errors are grouped by HTTP status; tool failures by tool and error type.
spec.title: Failures per Day by Reason

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN 'API' ELSE 'Tool' END AS "Kind",
  CASE f.failure_kind WHEN 'api_error' THEN CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) ELSE f.tool_name END AS "Tool / Model",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(f.error_type, ''), CONCAT('HTTP ', f.status_code), 'Unknown') AS "Error",
  NULLIF(f.error_message, '') AS "Message",
  COUNT(*) AS "Failures",
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.ai_prompt_id) AS "Prompts",
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)) AS "Users",
  MAX(f.occurred_at) AS "Last seen"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY 5 DESC, 1, 2, 3

spec.description: Every failure reason with how often it happened, how many prompts and users it hit, and when it last happened. Message is the API error's message; tool failures have none, because a tool's error message can echo file contents and is never stored.
spec.title: Top Failure Reasons

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(f.status_code AS CHAR), 'N/A') AS "Status",
  CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 1)), SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(f.model, '-[0-9]{8}', ''), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2.$3'), 'claude-([a-z]+)-([0-9]+)', '$1 $2'), 2)) AS "Model",
  CASE WHEN f.failure_kind <> 'api_error' THEN '' WHEN f.query_source = 'repl_main_thread' THEN 'Main conversation' WHEN f.query_source LIKE 'agent:%' THEN CONCAT('Subagent (', SUBSTRING_INDEX(f.query_source, ':', -1), ')') WHEN f.query_source = '' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE CONCAT('Background (', f.query_source, ')') END AS "Source",
  COUNT(*) AS "Errors",
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.ai_prompt_id) AS "Prompts",
  AVG(f.attempt) AS "Avg attempt",
  MAX(f.attempt) AS "Max attempt",
  MAX(f.occurred_at) AS "Last seen"
FROM ai_prompt_failures f
JOIN ai_prompts p ON p.id = f.ai_prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at)
  AND p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') IN (${repository:sqlstring})
  AND f.failure_kind = 'api_error'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1, 2, 3

FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name

-- The label is the person's full name from their DevLake account, falling back to the email; the value stays the
-- email (or user key) that every panel filters on.
SELECT COALESCE(u.full_name, u.user) AS __text, u.user AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) AS user,
    MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), '')) AS full_name
  FROM ai_prompts p
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = p.account_id
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1
) u
ORDER BY 1;

spec.definition:
-- Repositories the selected users' prompts ran in. 'Unknown' stands for prompts without a repository; a real
-- repository_url is always an https URL, so it cannot clash.
SELECT CASE WHEN r.url = 'Unknown' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(r.url, '^https?://', '') END AS __text, r.url AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(p.repository_url, 'Unknown') AS url
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT c_g.id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE c_g.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring})
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key) IN (${user:sqlstring})
) r
ORDER BY r.url = 'Unknown', 1;
